title: Hamster Village
subtitle: A Cozy Seasonal Coloring Book for Adults
tagline: Detailed Scenes to Color and Relax
author: Lanternsinthesky
back_blurb:
Step into a cozy village where little hamsters celebrate every season. Each single-sided page is a richly detailed scene packed with tiny characters, lanterns, gardens and festivals, made for markers, gel pens and colored pencils.

No experience needed. Pick your favorite colors and enjoy a quiet, creative break.
